description:
No. 6 Manor Drive is a superb four-bedroom semi-detached residence, ideally positioned within one of Wexford’s most sought-after residential developments, approximately 2.5km from Wexford Town Centre. Built in c. 2019, this impressive A-rated home is presented in exceptional condition throughout and offers bright, spacious and beautifully appointed accommodation. The interior has been thoughtfully designed and decorated, with a high standard of finish evident throughout, creating a stylish and welcoming home ready for immediate occupation. The well-proportioned accommodation briefly comprises entrance hall, spacious sitting room with feature electric fireplace, modern kitchen/dining room with sliding doors opening onto the rear garden, guest WC and utility room. The ground floor also benefits from a versatile additiona room, currently suitable for use as a downstairs bedroom, home office, second reception room or playroom. Upstairs, there are three generous bedrooms, including a well-proportioned main bedroom with ensuite, together with a beautifully appointed family bathroom. The property is presented in immaculate show-house condition and benefits from a superb range of quality finishes and upgrades. Features include a contemporary fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, attractive tiling, built-in wardrobes and modern fixtures and fittings throughout. The A-rated energy performance further enhances the appeal of this excellent home, offering modern levels of comfort and energy efficiency. Outside, the property benefits from a private driveway to the front and a low-maintenance rear garden. A particularly attractive feature of the property is its position overlooking a large green area, with pleasant views extending towards Rosslare and Wexford Harbour. The location is excellent, with Wexford Golf Club less than 1km away and a bus stop conveniently located close to the entrance to the development. The property also provides easy access to the N25 and N11, making it ideally positioned for commuting and access to surrounding towns and areas. A comprehensive range of amenities is available within easy reach, including primary and secondary schools, shops, supermarkets, restaurants, churches and leisure facilities, while Wexford Town Centre is approximately 2.5km away. No. 6 Manor Drive represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a modern, energy-efficient family home in a highly regarded residential location. With its superb condition, flexible accommodation, attractive outlook and convenient location, this beautiful property is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers. Viewing is highly recommended.
